text:
lena: noticed SCIM delta jobs failing after last night's IDP proxy rollout. Errors are InvalidAttributeEncoding on extId only.

raf: yikes. Any KMS rotations around that time?

lena: KMS rotate at 02:05 UTC, proxy deploy 02:30 UTC. stack shows h2 RST_STREAM then retry path strips X-Envelope header sometimes.

song-ops: can force h1 for a small sample to isolate h2. want me to flip 5%?

lena: please do 5% and enable "h2:frame" debug. if h1 fixes it, we escalate to IDP vendor.

raf: quick patch idea: if kmsClient.rewrapIfStale() returns null, abort retry. I'll open PR. Safer than sending unwrapped attrs.

audit-bot: logged incident INC-2026-777; rewrap events query id=rewrap:2026-05-01:02:05.

song-ops: 5% h1 run looks clean. h2 still flaky. collecting logs -> s3://triage/INC-2026-777/proxy-debug.tgz

lena: ok, keep ingress header validation too (reject missing X-Envelope). raf: ping when PR is up.

raf: PR opened -> scim-worker: abort-retry-on-rewrap-null, canary 3 instances. smoke passes.

lena: mitigating controls in place, incident -> MITIGATED. will schedule postmortem.
